# VigVibe — Scott Vigneault

Freelance creative direction, presentation design, and creative operations for B2B
marketing teams. Twenty years of in-house creative leadership, available one project
at a time. Based in Boston, working remotely across US time zones.

## What Scott does
- Campaign design: assets, systems, and brand consistency across every marketing channel.
- Deck rescue: structure, visual hierarchy, and design for sales decks, keynotes, and investor pitches.
- Creative ops: intake systems, better briefs, cleaner approvals, workflow design.
- AI workflows: practical AI integration for creative and marketing teams.

- /work — selected projects by category

- /blog — "This week in AI…", twice a month
- /downloads — free Claude Skills, Custom GPTs, and Gemini Gems for creative teams
